name: android-litert-runtime
description: Configures and implements LiteRT (.tflite) on-device inference on Android in Kotlin using the CompiledModel API on CPU and GPU. Use this skill for any Android LiteRT or .tflite task, including Gradle setup, image classification or vision/audio/embedding helpers, TensorBuffer reuse, Bitmap preprocessing, AndroidViewModel GPU-to-CPU fallback with warm-up on a single-thread dispatcher, migrating from legacy org.tensorflow.lite.Interpreter or GpuDelegate, and latency benchmarking. Don't use for running generative text LLMs with .litertlm files or for Python model conversion.
